title: IVG Intense Salts Retro Orange 10ml Nic Salts E-Liquid
description: IVG Intense Salts Retro Orange captures the bold, zesty flavour of classic Orange soda. The citrus notes are bright and juicy, paired with a gentle sweetness that rounds off the flavour and adds a nostalgic, drink-inspired character. This Nic Salt is blended at a 50VG/50PG ratio, providing consistent flavour, discreet vapour, and a tactile yet comfortable throat hit. Available in 10mg and 20mg strengths, Retro Orange is best suited to mouth-to-lung (MTL) pod kits, vape pens, and starter devices. Part of the IVG Intense Salts range, Retro Orange balances sharp Orange zest with smooth sweetness.
